name: Wix
description: Wix's hosted server manages sites and their business apps — stores, bookings, blogs — with your Wix account.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.wix.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
